middle-grade-illustrated.recipe.yaml:
schema: creation-recipe/v1

metadata:
  id: middle-grade-illustrated
  title: Middle Grade Illustrated Novel
  description: Starter for an illustrated 8–12 narrative project.
  tags:
    - middle-grade
    - illustrated

parameters:
  $ref: "./parameters.schema.json"

project:
  profiles:
    - "{{ audience }}"
  packs:
    - story_core
    - characters
    - editorial
    - visual_core
  skills:
    - story-intake
    - character-design
    - story-architecture
  publishingTargets:
    - print-pdf

initialGoals:
  - establish-story-bible
  - establish-main-cast
  - outline-story

# --- Additive optional keys per REQ-CR-2 ---

publishing:
  defaultTarget: print-pdf
  options:
    - print-pdf

recipeProfileAliasResolution:
  enabled: true
  aliasesFile: specs/profile-aliases.yaml

uiHints: {}

skeleton.profiles/profile-middle-grade-10-11.yaml:
# Middle Grade 10-11 profile
# Resolved from specs/profile-aliases.yaml

audience:
  ageRange: "10-11"
  gradeRange: "5th-6th grade"
  readingLevel: "independent reader"
  interests:
    - friendship
    - adventure
    - humor
    - mystery
  contentGuidelines:
    violence: low
    romance: none
    language: clean

narrative:
  preferredPOV: third-person-limited
  preferredTense: present
  chapterLengthTarget: 1500-3000 words

illustrations:
  style: graphic-novel-panels
  frequency: every-chapter
  panelCountTarget: 4-8 per chapter
